description: An arithmetic structure models \(Q\) exactly when its zero, successor, addition and multiplication satisfy all seven Robinson axioms.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.model_Q_iff.{u} (M : Type u)
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M] :
  M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.Q ↔
    (∀ (a : M),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M a ≠
          Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) ∧
      Function.Injective (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M) ∧
        (∀ (a : M),
            a ≠ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M →
              ∃ b, a = Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M b) ∧
          (∀ (a : M),
              Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M a
                  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) =
                a) ∧
            (∀ (a b : M),
                Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M a
                    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M b) =
                  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M
                    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M a b)) ∧
              (∀ (a : M),
                  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M a
                      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) =
                    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.zeroValue M) ∧
                ∀ (a b : M),
                  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M a
                      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M b) =
                    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.addValue M
                      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.mulValue M a b) a
